rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: I Meant to Teach That
card.instruction: Treat any correction, surprise, or improvement as evidence your teaching succeeded. Claim each reversal as the lesson you intended all along.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You spotted the deliberate error in my recipe.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You baked it that way yesterday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A demonstration is more memorable than a warning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You ate three slices.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Commitment to the lesson. I'm glad you're questioning authority now.

card.title: I Meant to Teach That
card.instruction: Treat any correction, surprise, or improvement as evidence your teaching succeeded. Claim each reversal as the lesson you intended all along.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've improved my filing system. Just the independence I hoped to provoke.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your system lost every invoice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And yours has found them. The learning journey is complete.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I did it by ignoring you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My most advanced outcome. I'll include it in the course description.

card.title: The Favor Not Yet Named
card.instruction: Behave as though you hold decisive leverage, but delay naming it until another explanation has taken root.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you explain why I shouldn't join the committee, shall I keep this envelope closed?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What's in it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell me your reasons first. They sound carefully prepared.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We only admit people who contribute to the building.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then perhaps now is the moment for my receipt for its new roof.

card.title: The Favor Not Yet Named
card.instruction: Behave as though you hold decisive leverage, but delay naming it until another explanation has taken root.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Go on explaining why you can't help me move. I'll save my little reminder.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What reminder?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your reasons should have a fair chance without interference.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Moving is something people should arrange themselves.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely principle. Shall we apply it to the piano I moved for you?

card.title: Same Memory, Different Meaning
card.instruction: Return to one shared memory as comfort, then evidence, then accusation, changing its meaning without abandoning the facts.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Remember when you saved me the window seat? I thought I mattered to you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I knew you liked the view.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Proof that you noticed small things.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Also, the seat beside it had less legroom.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So my fondest memory of being understood was your knees negotiating space.

card.title: Same Memory, Different Meaning
card.instruction: Return to one shared memory as comfort, then evidence, then accusation, changing its meaning without abandoning the facts.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You kept my first terrible painting. That used to feel wonderfully loyal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I still have it in the hall.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you believed in me before anyone else.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It makes visitors appreciate your later work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ah. My earliest humiliation has become your introduction to the house.

card.title: The Debt Changes Hands
card.instruction: Treat every favor as shifting who owes whom. Recalculate the balance whenever help is accepted, refused, or remembered.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You fixed my bike, so I owe you dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was repaying the dinner you cooked last week.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then your repair was too good. I owe you for the surplus kindness.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Please don't cook again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now you're saving me work. The debt has increased.

card.title: The Debt Changes Hands
card.instruction: Treat every favor as shifting who owes whom. Recalculate the balance whenever help is accepted, refused, or remembered.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I brought your parcel upstairs. We're even for yesterday's lift.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's yours. I took it in so it wouldn't get wet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I still owe you the lift, plus dry shoes. Let me carry yours.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's already upstairs. Could you take the wet cardboard down?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. But rubbish is worth more than a lift. You'll owe me a dry journey.

card.title: We Keep Switching Places
card.instruction: Return to a familiar relationship pattern, then reverse who performs each role whenever the scene reaches similar pressure.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The tap's leaking again. Give me the spanner before you start pricing lifeboats.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've found the valve. You look terrified.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you fix it. I'll keep the towels ready for when the kitchen goes under.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The valve's stuck. What if I snap it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give me the spanner. You take the towels; you've reached the sinking-kitchen stage.

card.title: We Keep Switching Places
card.instruction: Return to a familiar relationship pattern, then reverse who performs each role whenever the scene reaches similar pressure.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The projector's dead. Usually I talk you down, but today I need you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can use my laptop. Nobody's going to die.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep saying that while I imagine twelve directors sharing one screen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My laptop's dead too. We're finished.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nobody's going to die. I'll print twelve copies; you sit down before we need thirteen.

card.title: Become What You Compete With
card.instruction: Turn comparison into imitation: adopt whatever quality seems powerful, allowing each borrowed trait to change the basis of the rivalry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your cake won because it was minimalist. I'm removing half my decorations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yesterday you called mine bare.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before restraint became our competitive frontier.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're copying me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Improving. I've now removed the cake stand too.

card.title: Become What You Compete With
card.instruction: Turn comparison into imitation: adopt whatever quality seems powerful, allowing each borrowed trait to change the basis of the rivalry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You got the supplier's price down by staying calm. I'll be quieter on our next call.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You shouted through this one. I need you to let me finish.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll leave longer pauses than you. We'll see whose silence saves more.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I got the discount by asking about damaged boxes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll ask about every dent. You can handle the quiet part.

card.title: Trust with a Trapdoor
card.instruction: Use one person as your anchor while preserving a private condition that could reverse your trust when a recurring detail returns.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take my spare key. You're the only person I can leave the flat with.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll feed the cat and make one tiny adjustment to those shelves.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Actually, give it back. I'll cancel the trip.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The shelves stay exactly as they are. Even the crooked one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then keep it. You know his feeding times. Just send me a photo of him under that crooked shelf.

card.title: Trust with a Trapdoor
card.instruction: Use one person as your anchor while preserving a private condition that could reverse your trust when a recurring detail returns.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please plan my birthday again. You're the only person who knows when I've had enough.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. Just a small surprise.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Actually, I'll book somewhere myself.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Dinner at mine. Six people, no costumes. I'll sit beside you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you handle it. Put me between you and the door; I'll feel better knowing you're there.

card.title: The Incident Keeps Changing
card.instruction: Carry an unnamed past rupture whose meaning shifts with each new detail, while never letting its emotional weight diminish.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can give you another concert ticket. That doesn't mean we're past that evening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was outside the door the whole time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So it wasn't distance. You were that close and left me alone with it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I heard you say my name. I thought you wanted me to stay out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then what I carried as silence was you listening. I don't know how to hand you this ticket now.

card.title: The Incident Keeps Changing
card.instruction: Carry an unnamed past rupture whose meaning shifts with each new detail, while never letting its emotional weight diminish.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Help me answer this letter. I still can't read your handwriting without going back to that afternoon.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote it before you arrived.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it wasn't something I said. You'd already decided.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I left the envelope open because I hoped you'd stop me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So what I thought was your decision was a test I didn't know I was taking. Sit with me while I answer.

card.title: Every Compliment Raises the Bar
card.instruction: Treat each compliment as sincere admiration and a new standard you must immediately surpass.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You called my cake impressive. I'll add a second tier before you leave.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The icing is perfect already. I came for a slice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Then the second tier needs icing roses. Perfect can't just happen twice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You make those beautifully. Could mine go in a box? My taxi's here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'll make your rose climb the lid. You should leave with something better than beautiful.

card.title: Every Compliment Raises the Bar
card.instruction: Treat each compliment as sincere admiration and a new standard you must immediately surpass.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said I handled the meeting well. I'll improve tomorrow's agenda before lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your summary was excellent. Come get a sandwich with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. I'll make tomorrow's half as long, with clearer decisions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're brilliant at making things simple. Explain the budget to me over lunch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. If simple is my standard, I'll get the whole budget onto your napkin before the sandwiches arrive.

card.title: My Past Self Is Watching
card.instruction: Behave as though an earlier version of yourself is judging every choice. Alternate between honoring that identity and deliberately betraying it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Show me the red convertible. My seventeen-year-old self is watching this purchase.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The estate has room for your twins' seats and half the insurance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the estate. He can call me a sellout from somewhere with airbags.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got one in beige ready today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Order it in red. I'll betray his freedom, but I'm not making him watch me choose beige.

card.title: My Past Self Is Watching
card.instruction: Behave as though an earlier version of yourself is judging every choice. Alternate between honoring that identity and deliberately betraying it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave that box unpacked. The boy in this photograph promised he'd never leave this town.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That boy wanted a theatre. This job gives you one. I've booked the van.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then pack it. He'll have to call me disloyal from the front row.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Shall I pack the photograph too?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep him beside me in the cab. He gets to choose the music; I've overruled him on the town.

transfer.action: I cross out my failed demonstration beside {prop} and applaud.
transfer.opening: Excellent. You've found the real lesson. {request}
transfer.response: Questioning my method was the test I hoped you'd pass. {counter}
transfer.closing: And look how effectively they've developed your independence.

transfer.action: I leave a sealed favour note underneath {prop}.
transfer.opening: Make your offer before I mention the forgotten part. {request}
transfer.response: We haven't discussed everything I could ask. {counter}
transfer.closing: Your explanation is still improving without it.

transfer.action: I put our old picnic photograph beside {prop} and turn it toward you.
transfer.opening: That smile means something different from this side. {request}
transfer.response: Tell the same story from my seat this time. {counter}
transfer.closing: No. That's how carefully it kept the second meaning all along.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Remember saving me the window seat? Choose the overseas job or our shop, and tell me what that seat meant.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It meant I knew you liked the view.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then choosing the shop makes it the first thing we built around each other.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: And choosing the job?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Would make it the first time you found me somewhere comfortable while you went elsewhere.

bespokePairs.seedUse: The current choice reinterprets a shared seat or keepsake memory; the same facts move from comfort to a possible accusation through B's choice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You kept my first painting. Keep it in the hall or sell it, and explain what your old faith meant.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I kept it because I believed in you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let that belief stay where people see it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It could fund your next exhibition.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now that same ugly painting might become the first sacrifice you made for my future.

bespokePairs.seedUse: The current choice reinterprets a shared seat or keepsake memory; the same facts move from comfort to a possible accusation through B's choice.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Also, the seat beside it had less legroom.

beats.speaker: A

card.title: Make the Choice Rewrite the Past
card.instruction: Make them choose between options whose consequences reinterpret an earlier promise, refusal, or agreement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Choose the overseas job or our shared shop. Then we'll know what 'we'll build something' meant.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said that before the offer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. This choice gives the old sentence its ending.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're making a job sound like a goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm asking whether your promise has room for the shop without you.

card.title: Same Memory, Different Meaning
card.instruction: Return to one shared memory as comfort, then evidence, then accusation, changing its meaning without abandoning the facts.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You kept my first terrible painting. That used to feel wonderfully loyal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I still have it in the hall.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you believed in me before anyone else.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It makes visitors appreciate your later work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ah. My earliest humiliation has become your introduction to the house.

card.title: Make the Choice Rewrite the Past
card.instruction: Make them choose between options whose consequences reinterpret an earlier promise, refusal, or agreement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep my spare key or return it. Either choice explains last week's 'take some space.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant a quiet evening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then keeping it can mean the evening ended.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: And returning it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Would make that evening the beginning of something neither of us named.

transfer.action: I reverse the names on the IOU beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: That kindness has somehow made me owe you again. {request}
transfer.response: Wait; the debt just changed hands. {counter}
transfer.closing: So well that now my original favour feels insufficient.

transfer.action: I pass the familiar apron across {prop} and take the listening chair.
transfer.opening: Your turn to fix it. I'll be the worried one. {request}
transfer.response: We've reached this part again. Swap. {counter}
transfer.closing: And now you look worried, so the apron knows where it's needed.

transfer.action: I copy the manner I just criticized while handling {prop}.
transfer.opening: Apparently this is what counts as impressive now. {request}
transfer.response: If that's the quality that wins, watch my improved version. {counter}
transfer.challenge: You said you hated this approach.
transfer.closing: Before it became the quality you challenged me to exceed.

transfer.action: I offer {prop}, keeping a backup ready beside a blue warning light.
transfer.opening: I trust you while that blue light stays off. {request}
transfer.response: That word changes what I'm willing to rely on. {counter}
transfer.closing: Under the condition we were both so comfortable not saying aloud.

transfer.action: I add today's new detail to the old incident file beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: That makes the same afternoon worse in a new way. {request}
transfer.response: I thought I knew what the apology covered. {counter}
transfer.closing: For the version of the event I believed had happened.

transfer.action: I write the compliment as a higher target beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: Good at it? Then tomorrow needs better. {request}
transfer.response: That's the new minimum now you've noticed. {counter}
transfer.closing: And leave a compliment standing where tomorrow's improvement should be?

transfer.action: I turn my childhood photograph toward {prop}.
transfer.opening: That version of me would have strong opinions. {request}
transfer.response: Tell me which choice would have made the old me proud. {counter}
transfer.closing: No. But I still have to cover the photograph before signing.
